title: Admission and batching control room
description: Trade batch efficiency against queue delay, replica capacity, and explicit overload behavior.

profiles.label: Interactive ranking
profiles.detail: Small stateless requests with a tight user-facing deadline.

profiles.label: Mixed generation
profiles.detail: Variable request lengths create padding and execution-time skew.

profiles.label: Offline embedding
profiles.detail: Durable work can wait longer and benefits more from full batches.

policies.label: Queue everything
policies.detail: Accept all requests and let queue age reveal the overload cost.

policies.label: Shed by deadline
policies.detail: Reject work predicted to finish after its caller deadline.

policies.label: Route compatible fallback
policies.detail: Use a bounded lower-cost route, then reject any remaining excess.
